message.content: IllidanStormrage proposed two main ideas related to involving the community in supporting local businesses. Firstly, he suggested covering basic first aid, emergency response protocols, and communication strategies in training sessions. This ensures that there is preparedness and mutual support within the community in case of emergencies. Secondly, he outlined roles that participants could assume within the community emergency response team, including team leader, medic, communication officer, and someone responsible for managing logistics. These roles aim to foster a collaborative and organized approach towards supporting local businesses and ensuring their continuity in case of unexpected events. Additionally, it highlights the importance of community involvement and unity in promoting local businesses.
